paragraphs.text: Vryn is the homeplane of the blue-aligned planeswalker Jace Beleren .

The landscape of Vryn is littered with lines of gigantic inhabited mage-rings. Their age and origin are unknown, and many are in disrepair. The rings are controlled by ring mages and are conduits of mana . Enormous mana collection stations channel the energy of the leylines into the ring network.
The plane is often rainy. Jace Beleren described its smell as petrichor and charged ozone .

The Core States, sitting in the middle of the ring network, gathered all the energy of an entire continent for use by the mage elite from the Ampryn League. Power over the Core States and the mana stream was contested by the Trovian Separatists . Arbiters work to keep the conflict from escalating into destroying Vryn's infrastructure, but not all were concerned about the civilian cost of the war.

After the death of the arbiter Alhammarret , the fighting intensified and culminated in non-stop chaos. That particular section of Vryn became a failed state, with no permanent governance and continual unstable coups.

Vryn was a target in the New Phyrexian Invasion . Jace was directed to lead the invasion force, but his telepathic defense against psychic intrusion meant he was less effective as a commander. The denizens of Vryn were constantly prepared for war already, and defeated the Phyrexians by overloading the mage-rings, with the invasion ending a sometime before the end of Ravnica's invasion.

The inhabitants of Vryn use special nuptial bracelets to celebrate their marriages. The bride also dresses in the groom's family colors. The healer Ranna Beleren developed a method using Phoenix feathers in medicine as an alternative to organ replacement.
